## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 342 captures during July 2022. This activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The reported volume should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results requiring referral.

## Image quality

A total of 14 captures were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.1 of captures. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and identify any recurring issues that may affect the ability to complete grading. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be followed up through the appropriate process.

## Grading

There were 74 referable results during the reporting period. The median grading wait was 26 days. This measure indicates the typical time between capture and completion of grading, while the referable total identifies the results requiring onward attention. Activity, image quality and grading measures should be reviewed together to support routine site oversight and service monitoring.
